title: 消费者组分配策略与空闲消费者统计
expected_output:
=== 消费者组分配：range vs round-robin（两个 topic）===
topic A = 6 分区, topic B = 2 分区, 共 8 个分区; 消费者 = ['C0', 'C1', 'C2', 'C3']

range        分区数分布 = [3, 3, 1, 1]  极差 = 2
      C0   <- ['A-P0', 'A-P1', 'B-P0']
      C1   <- ['A-P2', 'A-P3', 'B-P1']
      C2   <- ['A-P4']
      C3   <- ['A-P5']

round-robin  分区数分布 = [2, 2, 2, 2]  极差 = 0
      C0   <- ['A-P0', 'A-P4']
      C1   <- ['A-P1', 'A-P5']
      C2   <- ['A-P2', 'B-P0']
      C3   <- ['A-P3', 'B-P1']

=== 结论（由实测分布推导）===
range       分布 = [3, 3, 1, 1], 极差 = 2
round-robin 分布 = [2, 2, 2, 2], 极差 = 0
-> range 按 topic 逐个切分：小 topic（B 只有 2 个分区）整段落到最前面的消费者，
   于是 C0/C1 各 3 个分区、C2/C3 各 1 个 -> 负载不均（这是 range 的已知短板）
-> round-robin 跨 topic 全局轮流，每个消费者恰好 2 个分区，最均衡
-> sticky 是 range/round-robin 的改进版：尽量保留上次分配、只迁移必要分区，
   既均衡又避免 rebalance 时大面积分区搬迁（代价是可能不如 round-robin 均匀）

=== 消费者数 > 分区数 时的空闲情况 ===
分区数        消费者数         活跃         空闲         每消费者分到
8          4            4          0          2.0 个
8          8            8          0          1.0 个
8          10           8          2          1.0 个
3          6            3          3          1.0 个

并行度上限 = min(分区数, 消费者数); 消费者多于分区 -> 多出的实例纯备位，不贡献吞吐
code:
print("=== 消费者组分配：range vs round-robin（两个 topic）===")
TOPICS = {"A": ["A-P%d" % i for i in range(6)],
          "B": ["B-P%d" % i for i in range(2)]}
CONSUMERS = ["C0", "C1", "C2", "C3"]


def assign_range(topics, consumers):
    """range: 对每个 topic 独立地把分区按消费者顺序切成连续段（Kafka 缺省策略）"""
    out = {c: [] for c in consumers}
    for tname in sorted(topics):
        parts = topics[tname]
        n, m = len(parts), len(consumers)
        per, extra = divmod(n, m)
        idx = 0
        for i, c in enumerate(consumers):
            take = per + (1 if i < extra else 0)
            out[c].extend(parts[idx:idx + take])
            idx += take
    return out


def assign_roundrobin(topics, consumers):
    """round-robin: 把所有 topic 的所有分区拉平后逐个轮流分配"""
    flat = []
    for tname in sorted(topics):
        flat.extend(topics[tname])
    out = {c: [] for c in consumers}
    for i, p in enumerate(flat):
        out[consumers[i % len(consumers)]].append(p)
    return out


total = sum(len(v) for v in TOPICS.values())
print("topic A = 6 分区, topic B = 2 分区, 共 %d 个分区; 消费者 = %s" % (total, CONSUMERS))
print()
sizes = {}
for name, fn in (("range", assign_range), ("round-robin", assign_roundrobin)):
    res = fn(TOPICS, CONSUMERS)
    s = [len(res[c]) for c in CONSUMERS]
    sizes[name] = s
    print("%-12s 分区数分布 = %s  极差 = %d" % (name, s, max(s) - min(s)))
    for c in CONSUMERS:
        print("      %-4s <- %s" % (c, res[c]))
    print()

print("=== 结论（由实测分布推导）===")
print("range       分布 = %s, 极差 = %d" % (sizes["range"], max(sizes["range"]) - min(sizes["range"])))
print("round-robin 分布 = %s, 极差 = %d" % (sizes["round-robin"], max(sizes["round-robin"]) - min(sizes["round-robin"])))
print("-> range 按 topic 逐个切分：小 topic（B 只有 2 个分区）整段落到最前面的消费者，")
print("   于是 C0/C1 各 3 个分区、C2/C3 各 1 个 -> 负载不均（这是 range 的已知短板）")
print("-> round-robin 跨 topic 全局轮流，每个消费者恰好 2 个分区，最均衡")
print("-> sticky 是 range/round-robin 的改进版：尽量保留上次分配、只迁移必要分区，")
print("   既均衡又避免 rebalance 时大面积分区搬迁（代价是可能不如 round-robin 均匀）")
print()
print("=== 消费者数 > 分区数 时的空闲情况 ===")
print("%-10s %-12s %-10s %-10s %s" % ("分区数", "消费者数", "活跃", "空闲", "每消费者分到"))
for n_part, n_cons in ((8, 4), (8, 8), (8, 10), (3, 6)):
    active = min(n_part, n_cons)
    idle = max(0, n_cons - n_part)
    print("%-10d %-12d %-10d %-10d %.1f 个" % (n_part, n_cons, active, idle, n_part / active))
print()
print("并行度上限 = min(分区数, 消费者数); 消费者多于分区 -> 多出的实例纯备位，不贡献吞吐")
